課程綱要.課程目標: 隨著各式科學領域中大數據的迅速發展，統計學習已成為一門重要的研究領域。本課程聚焦於理論與計算並重的統計方法介紹與應用，目的在於培養學生建構模型與分析複雜資料的能力。
課程綱要.授課內容:
This course introduces the fundamental concepts and methodologies in statistical learning. Emphasis is placed on both the theoretical foundations and computational implementations of modern statistical methods. The tentative course outline is as follows:
1. Introduction of Statistical Learning
2. Linear Regression
3. Classification Techniques
4. Resampling Methods
5. Model Selection and Regularization for Linear Models
6. Basis Expansions and Nonlinear Regression
7. Tree-Based Methods, Bagging, and Random Forests
8. Boosting and Ensemble Learning
9. Support Vector Machines (SVMs)
10. Deep Learning Fundamentals
11. Unsupervised Learning
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: James G., Witten D., Hastie T., and Tibshirani R. (2021). An Introduction to Statistical Learning with Applications in R, Springer.

課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程是為半年制研究生設計的。我們從回顧測度理論開始，介紹 Borel-Cantelli 引理，大數定律，Martingle等。目的是為在工作中運用概率的人們提供許多重要的想法和思考。
課程綱要.授課內容: “1. Review: Lebesque-Stieltjes measures and Caratheodory extension theorems 2. Review: Integration 3. Probability spaces and sigma-algebras 4. Random variables and distributions 5. Laws of large numbers and independence6. Weak laws of large numbers 7. Midterm exam8. Borel-Cantelli lemmas and Strong Laws of Large Numbers: Colivenko-Cantelli theorem and Central limit theorem 9. Zero-one laws and maximal inequalities 10. Independent sums and larges deviations 11. De Moivre-Laplace theorem, weak convergence and characteristic functions12. Central limit theorem and its variants13. Random walks: stopping times and recurrence 14. Random walks: renewal theory 15. Martingales and Radon-Nikodym derivatives 16. Final exam“
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: “Durret, R. Probability: theory and examples,(2nd edn.), Duxburry. Belmont. Calif, 2005WILLIAMS, David. Probability with martingales. Cambridge university press, 1991.“
課程綱要.評量配分比重: “In this course, we will have three quizzes (30％), midterm exam (35％), final exam (35％), and assignments (40％).“

課程綱要.課程目標: The goal of this course is to let student have basic background in the financial stochastic processes and the stochastic control which can be used to study further financial engineering.

課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Bjork, Tomas. Arbitrage Theory in Continuous Time (Oxford Finance Series) 4th Edition
課程綱要.彈性教學說明: 討論隨機分析的延伸課題，例如投資組合最佳化及隨機賽局。

課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程旨在幫助碩士生理解統計推論的基礎理論，運用相關方法進行分析與解決問題，並培養未來進一步修習高等統計課程的能力。
課程綱要.授課內容:
1. 資料縮減原則
2. 點估計
3. 假設檢定
4. 區間估計
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: George Casella and Roger L. Berger (2002), Statistical Inference, 2nd edition Bickel, P.J. and Doksum, K.A. (2007), Mathematical Statistics: Basic Ideas and Selected Topics, Vol. I, 2nd edition
課程綱要.評量配分比重: 作業 40% 期中考 30% 期末考 30%
